g.text: Reading order: a citizen use case on the left triggers AI services in the middle, which create work for staff on the right.
«include» — the behaviour always runs as part of the base use case. «extend» — it runs only when its guard holds:
Review low-confidence classification [classifier confidence < 0.75] Attach photo / Report by IVR [alternate intake channel chosen]
Handle escalation & reassign officer [SLA deadline passed, status ≠ RESOLVED] Reopen grievance [citizen rejects the resolution]
Supporting systems (Groq LLM, SMS gateway, map tiles) are implementation dependencies rather than actors — see the component and deployment diagrams.
